privatePriceDrop.question: Does the price of a private company drop by 5 for no sale in the first round?

buySellOrder.question: Is there a specific order to buying and selling on your turn?

firstSellRound.question: When can you first sell shares in a company?
firstSellRound.answer: From the second stock round onwards.

poolLimit.question: Does the bank pool have a per-company share limit?

certLimit.question: Player certificate limits
certLimit.answer: |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | In 3- or 4-player games, the limit for a director of a company that goes into     receivership is reduced by an additional 2 certificates

sameCompanyBuySell.question: Can you buy a certificate and immediately sell a certificate in the same company?
sameCompanyBuySell.answer: No. All selling precedes all buying.

parPrice.question: How is a share company's initial (par) price determined?
parPrice.answer: The CAR always has an initial price of 100. for all other companies the price is set by the player who purchases the President's certificate, choosing a value selected from a range of predefined prices.

initialTile.question: Where can you make an initial tile lay?

tileReplacement.question: Must a tile replacement extend existing track?

stationCost.question: Cost of station markers
stationCost.answer: 0 for the home base, then 40, then 100 for any other tokens for most companies; Commonwealth Railways has two free home bases and three further tokens that cost 100 each. 1849v1&3 All 0. They were paid for at flotation time: first round start-ups pay 0, others pay 100 (total), for 3 tokens. 1849v4 All 0. They were paid for at flotation time, for the fees shown in the table in rule 3.3.

multiStation.question: Can you lay more than one station marker per turn?

firstStationTiming.question: When is a company's first station marker laid?

twoStationsOneTile.question: Can one train run to two stations on the same tile?

maxRevenue.question: Must the maximum possible revenue be claimed?

forcedTrainAfford.question: When a company is forced to buy a train and cannot buy one with its own means, what train may it then buy?
forcedTrainAfford.answer: The next new train from the bank.

privateTradeCompany.question: Are private companies purchasable by share companies?
privateTradeCompany.answer: Yes, once a 3/3+ train has been sold, in the price crange shown on the private company certificate. 1849v4 From phase 6 to phase 10.

privateClosing.question: Does using a private company's special property close it?
privateClosing.answer: Only the NAR when it buys its first train. 1849v4 Only the CNM and the SMS.

answer.effects: Yellow tiles, lay one tile, train limit 4, 1 OR
Green tiles, lay two yellow tiles, 2 ORs, privates may be bought by companies,     companies may buy trains from each other, loans may be taken out, Bank of England minimum     dividend of 10
Brown tiles, train limit 2, 3 ORs, private companies close, 2E (The Ghan) trains     available, Bank of England minimum dividend of 20
3 trains rust, COM can operate without needing a link from Adelaide to Sydney
Grey tiles, 4 trains rust, Bank of England minimum dividend of 30

miscellaneous.question: Miscellaneous
miscellaneous.answer: The Bank of England is a company that issues loans and administers companies in receivership. The game end can be triggered when the fifth company goes into receivership or when the Bank of England has issued 16 or more loans.
